notes.title: Here Be Dragons leaves Early Access on 30 Jan 2020
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that on [b]January 30, 2020[/b] Here Be Dragons will leave Early Access.

For the last few months (161 days to be exact) we have worked hard to finish the game. We added new enemies, skills, combats, captains, scenarios, maps and numerous tweaks and bug fixes to create smooth and seamless gameplay.

We started with just a bunch of missions and beginning of the story and finally, we are proud to confirm that Here Be Dragons includes:

[list][*]13 campaigns with over 40 battles
[*]over 30 types of enemies
[*]9 environmental effects
[*]10 colorful Captains with questionable sanity
[*]1 parrot
[*]1 completely real beard
[*]full story of Avant Armada
[/list]

Thank you very much for your support, ideas, comments and bug reports.

We hope you will enjoy the full version of Here Be Dragons and, as always, we are standing ready to provide support and fixes as needed.

Join us on January 30, 2020, at [b]09:00 PMT / 12:00 EST / 17:00 GMT /  18:00 CET[/b] to watch the live stream of the full game.

[b]P.S. After leaving Early Access price of the game will increase. Thank you for understanding.[/b]

notes.title: Patch Fish V0.31 - "Faster Than Catamaran"
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33658321/3ac92325cce2de221f9759f8e9bafcd8702b2e38.gif[/img]

Please see below details of changes that were introduced in the update.

[b]Patch notes[/b]

[h1]You asked for it[/h1]
[list]
[*] Auto Cherub - you don't have to choke the Cherub manually (you can change it in Battle Options). 
[*] Fast actions - you don't have to click to execute an action (you can change it in Battle Options).
[*] Fast Compass – speed of phase animation has been increased (you can change it in Battle Options).
[*] More interesting campaign 3 ("Whale Hunting") - faster & more challenging.
[*] Faster tutorial - removal of unnecessary texts & less fluff. 
[*] Added suggestions after defeat in two tutorial battles (1.4 - Island with natives, 2.2 - Pirate Black Christopher).
[*] Added “Restart” button in Battle Options.
[*] Added “Restart” button on the Defeat Screen.
[*] The Cherub spits out dice faster.
[*] The dice land faster in a free pool.
[*] Salvos with no damage do not execute.
[*] Fixed crash when using a die before a free pool was sorted.
[*] Fixed a word "Heal" in Polish version (using Errata function).
[*] Added Frame Limiter for powerful GPU.
[/list]

[h1]UI and Effects[/h1]
[list]
[*] Captain Fish says "Fish!" in Booty Phase; Captain Singer sings in Booty Phase 
[*] You can skip preparation to battle cutscene (when ships & enemies take their positions) by mouse click
[*] Blocking the dice in a free pool during Reroll.
[*] Blocking the dice in a free pool during Assign dice by AI.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Occasional crash in initializing Mermaid's Nest in 6.1 scenario.
[*] Too long pause between die's explosion and showing a hit.
[*] T-pose sailors animation in the Tavern.
[*] Mermaid's hair no longer change colour.
[*] Increased click area for Island with natives.
[*] Camera glitch in transition during back from combat screen to campaign screen.
[*] UI glitch in transition during first Salvos in 1.1 scenario.
[/list]

We are very sorry, but we can't add [b]Undo[/b] option in this update. It's almost ready, but not stable enough. We will add it as soon as possible. 

Please let us know if the game plays better and we very much appreciate all your feedback and additional ideas.

[b]We will be focused on new content from now on. The time has come for you to meet infamous, blood-thirsty, ruthless Captain Blackbeard.

Stay tuned.[/b]

notes.title: Captain's log - 2 days at sea
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33658321/20a0dc4c5c784451967550eef60f5fdb5f12102f.gif[/img]

[i]We managed to leave the port without unexpected problems - although as expected we had to come back to refill our rum supply.

Polly is very excited if not little annoying - she keeps screaming "choke, choke, choke" everytime she sees our cook. 

I am starting to worry about our navigator - every evening he comes and wants to re-do his course - maybe hiring the cheapest guy in the port wasn't such a good idea...

Tomorrow we should finally see our first whale. Can't wait for those exciting chases...[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33658321/a862b331090740356b64d0ba7f1cf86f5e23a573.png[/img]

[b]Thank you[/b] very much for all your support, questions, suggestions, reviews and video content. We really appreciate that. 

We will work hard to make sure that both currently available campaigns and new additional adventures will be fun (and surprising), well balanced, and very playable.

Our current plan is to provide you with new builds regularly (unless we need to immediately kill some very nasty bug). That will of course depend on actual amount of the new content and our RUM supply.

Next upcoming build will focus on adding some additional options, fixing balance of certain scenarios and eliminating all bugs we (and you) could find. The most important fixes:

[list]
[*] [b]UNDO option[/b] - ability to reset your turn (unfortunately no cheating with dice though)

[*][b] Auto-cherub[/b] - we will allow you to actually choke it for good, so he will offer all dice automatically

[*] [b]Stronger wind[/b] - we will tweak our animations and UI so you can sail faster and more smoothly 

[*] [b]Whales [/b]- we understand that combats with them are a bit boring and too long - we will look into making them faster and more fun

[*] Behind the curtains preparations for additional campaigns (in following build)
[/list]

notes.title: Put to sea in the middle of August (Early Access)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33658321/22efc060b0a57d63973f2b0042e8315469a48917.gif[/img]

Yeah! Here Be Dragons will finally arrive. The game will be available in the Early Access phase in the middle of August ([u]the most likely 15th-16th August 2019[/u]). 

We are very happy that we will be able to show you adventures of the Avant Armada and reveal real Columbus story. The truth that officials wanted to erase will be hidden no more!

We can't wait to read your impressions.

But back to the meritum of the case. The most important Q&A for the Early Access phase:

[h1]Why Early Access?[/h1]

Here Be Dragons is in a solid, playable state. We'd like to know what players think about the game during development. Players can enjoy interesting gameplay and story of our title while waiting for advanced scenarios and challenges.

[h1]Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?[/h1]

We expect to be in Early Access for 3-6 months. The time depends on players’ feedback. If there are many sugestions, development time may be extended.

[h1]How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?[/h1]

We plan to add new 6-8 campaigns (18-24 scenarios) containing new enemies, story characters, player skills and challenges. We will try to improve optimizations for different configurations and we will add missing features. Updates will be releasing at regular intervals.

[h1]What is the current state of the Early Access version?[/h1]

The game is already very playable. The current state of Here Be Dragons is:
[list]
[*] 6 campaigns
[*] 20 scenarios
[*] 4 captains
[*] 15 types of enemies
[*] over 20 player skills.
[/list]

We have full, very clear tutorial, important part of main story, advanced state of mechanics, finished UI and - last but not least - a lot of humour.

[h1]Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?[/h1]

The price will rise after Early Access.

The price won’t rise due to the additional content added during Early Access.

[h1]How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?[/h1]

We use our Steam forums and our Discord to receive players comments & opinions. We are always open for the feedback about balance, UI comfort, gameplay details and bugs.
